title: Replace epic_27_story_4_widget_golden_test.dart's 'AC structural verification' tautologies with real assertions
why: All three assertions are structurally guaranteed to pass regardless of the real code: (1) a bare class-type literal like `BulkMarkScreen` is never null in Dart — this can only fail if the file doesn't compile; (2) `shapes` at line 345-350 is a locally hardcoded copy of the golden-loop shape list (lines 107-112), fully disconnected from it — deleting 3 of the 4 real `goldenTest('track_card_...)` calls would not fail this test; (3) `expectedLocales` at line 360 is a hardcoded 2-element literal, disconnected from golden_runner.dart — changing that helper to skip the Hebrew variant (exactly what the comment at line 358-359 claims this test guards against) would not fail it either.
recommendation: Replace with real assertions: e.g. have golden_runner.dart expose the locale list / registered test count it actually iterates, and assert against that value, not a local copy; for BulkMarkScreen, either delete the vacuous check or assert something meaningful about its public constructor surface.
acceptance_criteria: The 'AC structural verification' tests fail when the real 4-shape loop or the real he-locale emission in golden_runner.dart is removed/broken.
